name: Column Grid Transition
description: Pinned full-screen scroll sequence where each image is revealed through a grid mask that opens column by column with shuffled cells, with animated text overlays and a segmented progress bar.
contents: Full-screen image slides with kicker, title, description and counter
behavior: Scroll-scrubbed timeline opens an SVG cell mask column by column, random order inside each column
Slide text wipes in and out with a clip-path
Column count changes at mobile and tablet breakpoints and rebuilds on resize
editableByProps: Grid density per breakpoint, cell stagger, scrub and scroll smoothness

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the mask reveal order (for example rows instead of columns)
Dim or remove the image darkening
needsCodeEdit.where: brightness(0.75) filter on the image element

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Section height is slides count times 100vh to give the pinned scroll room
Loads Playfair Display and Space Mono from Google Fonts at mount
